info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Promotional Events Query API allows users to retrieve detailed information about specific marketing promotional events based on a unique parameter. This endpoint serves marketing teams and business analysts looking to analyze event performance and customer engagement. By providing the parameter, consumers can access tailored marketing insights and relevant event details. Ideal for applications focused on marketing strategies and promotional optimization, this API enhances data-driven decision-making in marketing campaigns.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a promotional event by ID.
get.description: Fetch the specific details of a promotional event using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access all relevant information associated with the promotional event to effectively manage marketing strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve promotional event details for the specified resource identifier. The request expects a JSON payload that adheres to the defined schema and enables effective handling of the promotional events data.

200.description: Successful retrieval of promotional event details.

GetMarketingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation related to promotional events in the marketing service.
